name: agent-team-runner
description: Reusable local orchestrator for Lead/Worker/Reviewer/Integrator coding agents with Git worktrees and SQLite.

scripts.gen:codex: codex app-server generate-ts --out src/agent/codex/protocol && find src/agent/codex/protocol -name '*.ts' -exec sed -i '' -E 's/from "\./([A-Za-z0-9_/]+)"/from ".\/\1.js"/g; s/from "\.\./([A-Za-z0-9_/]+)"/from "..\/\1.js"/g' {} + && codex --version > src/agent/codex/protocol/GENERATED_FROM
scripts.test:protocol: npm run build && AGENT_TEAM_PROTOCOL=1 node --test --test-force-exit test/integration-backends.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && AGENT_TEAM_INTEGRATION=1 node --test --test-force-exit test/integration-backends.test.mjs test/integration-claude.test.mjs
